Exterior concept only — NOT printable or assembly-ready CADThese are provisional exterior envelopes. Underside cavities, clutch fit, strength, support, build order and printing are unverified. Counts include the shell and internal ribs, but exclude a stand, hinges, spares and fit coupons. Manufacturing design is on hold.

  
The 60 cm class targets 608 mm; the 100 cm class targets 992 mm. These are grid-aligned size classes, not exactly 60.00 or 100.00 cm.

    Controls, data and libraries
    
There is no ground plane blocking the underside. Z is up; the front is −Y. Auto-rotation is off initially, and hidden tabs pause rendering and rotation.

    
Keyboard: Tab to the 3D canvas, use arrow keys to orbit, +/− to zoom, and Home to reset to the front.

    
Dimensions, counts, colors and placements are generated from the eight JSON datasets. Studs use 12-sided envelopes. Lighting differs from the rendered comparison images. Thin edge shading is a visual aid and does not alter brick geometry.

    
This HTML embeds Three.js, OrbitControls and all eight models, so a saved copy works offline on its own. No CDN, login or local server is needed. Comparison and language links require their companion pages. WebGL 2 must be available for 3D rendering.

    
Exception messages, API names and stack traces are shown verbatim in diagnostics for troubleshooting.
